hg_regular.note: Every vertex lies in exactly d members of the supplied family (A10 incidence_degree); arbitrary finite carrier, E before d; empty carrier regular of every degree, empty members never count; Boolean view hg_regularP.

iregular.note: Every vertex has an injective I_r-indexed enumeration of exactly its neighbours; local existential enumerators, no choice or decidability, r before G; empty carrier regular at every r, r = 0 iff no adjacency; finite_sub of each neighbourhood derived from the same enumerator.
